candidate.name: intraday_interbar_gap_discovery_share_238p
candidate.mechanism: Scale-free allocation of within-half one-minute price discovery between interbar open-versus-prior-close discontinuities and the same destination bars' intrabar high-low ranges
candidate.formula: For each of 119 transitions in each half set g_j=abs(ln(open_j/close_j-1)) and r_j=ln(high_j/low_j); pool 238 pairs and score G/(G+R).
candidate.zero_rule: Exact zero gaps and exact zero destination ranges remain valid zero contributions. Require finite positive ordered OHLC on all 240 selected bars and finite strictly positive G+R; use no tolerance for gap classification, dropped pair, pseudocount, threshold, or substituted observation.
candidate.fixed_grid: Require the raw 09:30 row for source identity, use exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00, exclude 09:30, and reset the predecessor at lunch. No lunch, overnight, cross-day, or cross-stock transition is formed.

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Multiply every selected OHLC value by one common strictly positive constant.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign092_result: unchanged because every gap and range is a log ratio

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Multiply every interbar gap magnitude and destination range magnitude by one common positive constant while preserving the same 238 supports.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign092_result: unchanged because G and R scale together
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: raw range, volatility, and gap-magnitude level factors

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Increase one interbar gap magnitude while holding every destination range and other gap fixed.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign092_result: strictly increases when the score is below one
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: gap absorption counts, gap-body sign correlation, and body-next-gap reversal

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Increase one destination high-low range while holding every gap and other range fixed.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign092_result: strictly decreases when G is positive
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: directional range mass, range clock center, range entropy, and total range families

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Flip the sign of one gap without changing its absolute log magnitude or any destination range.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: gap-body confirmation, body-next-gap reversal, signed path, and directional price-impact factors

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Change whether a prior close lies inside the destination high-low interval while preserving the exact gap and destination range magnitudes.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: microgap absorption share and adjacent interval overlap

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Change amount and volume paths while preserving OHLC.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: amount timing, amount shape, range-amount, transaction-price, and VWAP families

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Move an otherwise identical transition across the lunch boundary.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign092_result: the transition is excluded because each half resets independently
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: full-day adjacent close paths and lunch repricing mechanisms

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_interbar_gap_body_confirmation_238p
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: The terminal factor correlates signed gaps with signed own-bar bodies. Campaign092 discards gap sign and body information and measures absolute gap mass relative to destination high-low range mass.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_microgap_absorption_share_238p
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both use the same within-half transition support
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: The terminal factor counts whether a nonzero gap is geometrically re-entered by the destination interval and requires 30 informative gaps. Campaign092 uses continuous magnitude allocation, credits exact-zero gaps as zero mass, and has no absorption predicate or count threshold.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_body_next_microgap_reversal_238p
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: The terminal factor measures signed reversal between a body and the next gap. Campaign092 uses absolute contemporaneous boundary magnitude and the destination bar's high-low range, with no body or reversal sign.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_intrabar_body_range_efficiency_240m and intraday_directional_range_mass_imbalance_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: all allocate or compare price movement with high-low range
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: The terminal factors use each bar's own open-close body magnitude or sign. Campaign092 never uses own-bar body and instead compares the destination range with the discontinuity from the prior close to the current open.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_adjacent_range_overlap_continuity_238p and intraday_range_boundary_translation_coherence_238p
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Those terminal factors compare neighboring high-low intervals or high/low changes. Campaign092 uses only prior close-to-current-open gap magnitude plus the current interval width; it never computes interval overlap or high/low co-movement.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_price_update_share_238m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both can respond to sparse price updating
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: The terminal factor is an exact adjacent-close update count. Campaign092 is continuous, requires OHLC, and can vary while every adjacent close update indicator is unchanged.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: candidate49_intraday_cumulative_vwap_crossing_rate_240m_v1
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both use a completed intraday grid
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Candidate49 counts causal close-versus-cumulative-VWAP sign crossings and requires volume/amount. Campaign092 never constructs VWAP, reads no activity field, and does not touch the prospective ledger.

prevalue_semantic_decision.required_next_step: Freeze the exact coverage-first no-return protocol and one-factor catalog against this audit and policy v35 before source rows or candidate values.
